core_idea: Heishou Pack - Si Branch Rodion is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. **Heishou Pack** — in Chain Battles, fill backup deployment slots with other Sinners so substitutes enter when a deployed unit **dies** or **Retreats**.
playstyle_guide:
- Chain Battles only — each Sinner equips **one identity**; **death** or **Retreat** Substitutes a backup Sinner in with a fresh rotation. Stagger does not.
- Another **Heishou Pack** identity on a backup **Sinner** is ideal — faction passives and **The Lord of Hongyuan** procs stack across the substitute queue.
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Serpent's Mortal Flurry** — **S1 — Serpent Glint** adds **+2 Poise Count** at **On Use**; **S2 — Snake Fang** adds **+2 Poise Count** on **Clash Win**.
- **Serpent's Mortal Flurry** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- **Guard: Reversal Kick** grants 3 **Serpent Arm** automatically at Combat Start — you already have it on turn one; no defense turn required.

**S1 — Serpent Glint** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- Coin Power +1 for every 10 (Poise on self + Rupture on target) (max 2); [On Use] Gain +2 Poise Count

**S2 — Snake Fang** (BP 4, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- Coin Power +1 for every 10 (Poise on self + Rupture on target) (max 2); [Clash Win] Inflict +2 Rupture Count; [Clash Win] Gain +2 Poise Count
- Peak output requires both conditions: At 30+ Poise, consume 10 Poise on self to Reuse Coin once (1 time max) | [On Hit] Inflict Deathrite — Venom —.

**S3 — Serpent's Mortal Flurry** (BP 5, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average).
- Unfocused Volley ; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 10 (Poise on self + Rupture on the main target) (max 2) ; [On Use] Gain Clash Power equal to Serpent Arm on self ; [On Use] Gain 3 Serpent Arm ; [Clash Win] Inflict +1 Rupture Count on all targets
- Inflict +1 Rupture Count; [On Crit] Reduce Deathrite — Venom — on target by 1; [On Crit] Reuse this Coin once (2 times per Skill)

Combat passive — **Heishou Mutation [Si]**: If this unit has Serpent Arm, deal +5% damage.
  - If target has Deathrite — Venom —, deal +5% damage.

Combat passive — **Intravascular Venom**: When 1 ally with the fastest Speed inflicts Rupture damage to an enemy, inflict 1 Offense Level Down and 1 Defense Level Down next turn (….

Defense skill — **Guard: Reversal Kick**: Clashable Guard.
  - [Combat Start] Gain 3 Serpent Arm next turn.
  - [On Use] At 10+ Poise Count, Coin Power +1.
